sloka: कथय त्वं ममोपायं केनोपायेन मन्थरे ।भरतः प्राप्नुयाद्रज्यं न तु रामः कथंचन ॥२-९-९॥
transliteration: kathaya tvaṁ mamopāyaṁ kenopāyena manthare ।bharataḥ prāpnuyādrajyaṁ na tu rāmaḥ kathaṁcana ॥2-9-9॥

translations.english: O Manthara, tell me the means by which Bharata and not Rama will secure the kingdom in any circumstances.
